name: pi-atomic-loop
description: Atomic coding cycles for pi — supervised or autonomous mode, one genuinely fresh Pi session per atom (conversation history is never durable state), durable handoff via GOAL.md/PROGRESS.md/TESTMANUAL.md/ASSUMPTIONS.md/IMPROVEMENTS.md plus Git checkpoints. Supervised mode does exactly one small atomic task per operator-driven cycle; autonomous mode runs until MVP with a new Pi session per atom. Includes the cross-session regression protocol, a test-matrix + implementation-first workflow, objective goal function (--check) with score/regression tracking, error retry with backoff, layered anti-repetition and degenerate-generation defenses, rescue model, LLM-independent context-overflow recovery, and bounded per-iteration JSONL stats with auto-resume.
author: fbezruchko

scripts.lint: for file in extensions/index.ts src/*.ts tests/*.test.ts tests/helpers/*.ts; do node --check "$file"; done
